environment.description: Linux; frozen CW-10 candidate; real Git repositories/worktrees and persistent host-shell fixtures; worker and independent suites

items.evidence: The 33-test runtime used real Git repositories and detached worktrees to verify full explicit commit OIDs, canonical external empty targets, exact cwd/HEAD, preserved dirty and untracked source state, retained execution worktrees, and fail-closed reporting for invalid commit/target/preparation without development-directory fallback. The actual OMP probe independently verified the prepared commit and retained worktree.

Real Git runtime tests verify the workflow only prepares a detached worktree from the manager-supplied local commit and never invokes commit, push, merge, stash, reset, or clean; unrelated dirty/untracked source files remain byte-for-byte/status preserved. WORKTREE-GUIDE separately assigns selective local commit preparation to Manager and excludes push/merge authority.
